body: Sulit calculation dito is unusual: zero purchase needed, free official remedy, at minutes lang ang initial model check—so hindi kailangan ng precise fire probability para maging rational ang action. Pero don't turn the recall into an excuse to replace a whole aircon at your own expense before verification. Check eligibility first; if covered, use the free inspection/repair or replacement route. Convenience cost lang ang pangunahing tradeoff, not a reason to buy new prematurely.

claims.text: Because the official remedies are free, verifying recall eligibility before paying for a replacement avoids unnecessary spending while preserving the safety benefit.
claims.basis: Value inference from the article's established free-remedy facts.
